turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'd like to hear what you have to say about this zero.
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No, thank you. I'm not here for coffee, Hale. Why was a zero entered in the gradebook before anyone called me?
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Don't manage me, Hale. Hard for you isn't what I asked, so who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect" is a generous way to put it. The company that sells that checker says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
I'm writing down 11:31, 612 words at 11:52, and 794 at 11:58. Which night is that, Hale? Turn the screen so I can read it myself.
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Don't manage me, Hale. You still haven't told me which night that was.
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
I'm not here to grade you, Hale. I'm here about Owen, and you've dodged the date twice now. Which night, and is the zero coming off?
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.

I'm writing that down, word for word. A line that isn't in the play is a line in an essay, Hale, and it proves nothing about who wrote it. Show me where it appears, and tell me who checked it against the text.
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
Students change direction between an outline and an essay, Hale. That's what drafting is. Do you have the outline with you, or is that another thing I'm supposed to take on your word?
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? I have a client call in fifteen minutes. The outline, Hale.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.

That's already in your own procedure, Hale, so it isn't a favour. The zero comes off first, and I want every word of this in writing. And you still haven't answered whether Owen was heard before it went in.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
You're asking me how to do your job? Owen found out from a gradebook on his phone, in the middle of a class. Withdraw the zero, Hale, and then we'll talk about what anyone says to him.
